topic: A teacher receives an unexpected gift from a former student
text: The sun was low, casting a warm glow through the classroom windows as I sorted the last of the papers. A knock at the door broke the quiet—a soft, hesitant tap. There, standing just outside the light, was a figure from the past. They held out a small, wrapped box, eyes downcast. For a moment, I could only stare, the weight of the day slipping away. The room, so familiar, seemed suddenly different, charged with a gentle, unspoken warmth. I took the gift, my fingers brushing against the paper, delicate and unexpected. The student smiled, a shy, brief thing before they were gone, leaving the air tingling with what had just passed.
